data.name: Nipun
data.gender_notes: Nipun is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Nipun means 'deep' or 'intense'. In Hindu mythology, the name is associated with Lord Vishnu, symbolizing the deep and profound qualities of the deity. The name Nipun carries the meaning “Deep, Intense” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Nipun usually hope their child will grow to embody deep, intense and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the depth and intensity of one's spiritual journey.
data.etymology: Nipun belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Deep, Intense.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nipun total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
